system.description: During the course of an investigation, your questions sometimes elicit an angry or even violent response. Through dissembling, verbal distraction, or similar evasion, you prevent a living foe from attacking anyone or anything for one round if you succeed on a charm, deception, intimidation, or other interaction task. Action.
